critical_code_review_comments: admin_portals.py toggle-off deliberately overwrites status='disabled' AND toggle-on does not restore prior status — documented behavior. The review request itself contains an internal inconsistency (asks status='private_beta' in select after toggle-disable+reload, but its own earlier assertion says toggle-off forces status=disabled). Implemented behavior matches the earlier binding assertion. If the desired UX is to preserve prior status across a toggle, the router needs to snapshot pre-disable status and restore it on toggle-on — currently the founder must manually re-set status after re-enable.
Route order: admin_portals.py uses realm_id in path params before validating via _validate_realm_id; unknown realms surface 404 correctly. No 500-path found.
MongoDB _id is properly stripped via _clean() and projection={_id:0} in the /overrides list. Good hygiene.

AdminPortalDetail.jsx panels use per-panel save buttons — reduces cross-field race conditions but requires the user to click multiple Save buttons. Consider a single 'Save all' shortcut for founder productivity.
